# Sanchez Construction Services
> General contractor in Laredo, Texas. Commercial and residential construction, including new construction and repairs/restorations. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews.

- Address: 2507 Market St, Laredo, TX 78043
- Phone: (956) 206-3885
- Email: jcsanc@sbcglobal.net
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8 AM–6 PM; Saturday and Sunday closed
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=174853116217362907

## Services (23)
- Commercial Construction: New construction and repairs/restorations for businesses. Occupied, fully operational job sites are never a problem, and multi-phase jobs can be planned, managed and built.
- Residential Construction: Construction and repair work for homes, from a single fix to a larger project.
- Remodels: Interior remodels that rework existing rooms and spaces.
- Cabin Finish Outs: Interior finish outs that turn a shell into a finished, livable cabin.
- Painting: Interior and exterior painting.
- Drywall Repairs & Installation: Drywall installation and repairs.
- Flooring Installation: Flooring installation, including tile and wood-look plank floors.
- Bathroom Remodeling: Bathroom remodels, from tub-and-tile to a finished walk-in shower.
- Suspended Ceiling Installation: Suspended (drop) ceiling grid and tile installation for commercial spaces.
- Glazing: Glass and glazing work, such as storefront-style glass doors.
- Roofing Repairs & Installations: Roof repairs and installations, including new shingle roofs.
- Masonry: Masonry work on block and brick walls.
- Block Fences: Concrete block fence construction.
- Cement Slabs: Concrete slab pours and finishing.
- Asphalt: Asphalt paving.
- Parking Lot Asphalt & Restriping: Parking lot asphalt and restriping, with stalls, arrows and hatched zones.
- Landscaping Services: Landscaping services for residential and commercial properties.
- Ranch Services: Ranch work and land clearing with heavy equipment.
- Septic Tank Services: Septic tank services.
- Dump Trailer Services: Dump trailer services for hauling material such as gravel.
- Moving Services: Moving services with a stake-bed truck.
- Furniture Assembly: Furniture assembly, including office workstations.
- Gazebo Assembly: Gazebo assembly for backyards and outdoor living areas.

## How a build runs
- Pre-Construction: budgets, schedules and close work with the design team.
- Construction: trusted subcontractors kept accountable; sequence, production and quality control.
- Post-Construction: site cleanup, systems training, final inspections, move-in coordination and a final walkthrough.
